h: From His Holy Manuscript: Hashem Hears When We Hear

p: some words from his holy manuscript.
And although it was not completed,
out of love for what is holy
we have printed it and not left it aside.
At the close of the blessing of Shofaros:
"For You hear the sound of the shofar
and give ear to the teruah," etc.,
Who hears the sound of the teruah of," etc.
This implies that the main thing is
should hear the sound of the shofar.
And so too it is written
regarding the secret of the shofar blasts,
the mitzvah ought to be fulfilled
yet the essence of the mitzvah
and we bless "to hear the sound of the shofar,"
One may answer that this is
in the sense of "Hashem is your shadow"
Hashem, may He be blessed, also hears.
And regarding all the mitzvos it is said
"And you shall walk in His ways,"
for they are all the ways
of Hashem, may He be blessed.
As they said in the Midrash Rabbah
(and as they said in the Gemara
for they are the laws of His conduct;
which is why it was through the Torah
And regarding the mitzvah of Shabbos
it is stated explicitly in the pasuk
that on it He rested and ceased,
As they said in the Tanchuma,
just as I rest on it."
And so it is with all the mitzvos.
like a monkey before a man";

inlineHeadings.text: "For You hear the sound of the shofar"
Why the mitzvah is hearing, not blowing

paragraphs.text: Parallel: R. Yaakov Yosef of Polonne, Toldos Yaakov Yosef, Pinchas — “‘For You hear the sound of the shofar’ — from afar, for the tzaddik; ‘and give ear to the teruah’ — from near, for the baal teshuvah. This seems contrary to nature, and the answer is that in truth there is none like You in this, out of Your mercy. And with this the words of the Rambam are understood, that the mitzvah is not to blow but to hear the teruah of the shofar: for through hearing the sound of the shofar, which wakes the sleepers from their slumber, a person returns in teshuvah; and this is called ‘the teruah of the shofar,’ which is the essence of the mitzvah.” Connection: Toldos divides the closing words of Shofaros between tzaddik and baal teshuvah, as Rav Tzadok weighs what is heard when the shofar is not blown.

paragraphs.text: Zohar III 99b (Emor) — "With these sounds below Israel give strength to mercy from below, and the great shofar is aroused above; therefore we must prepare a shofar on this day and arrange sounds, with intent, in order to arouse that other shofar in which the sounds above are included."

paragraphs.text: Tosafos, Rosh Hashanah 16b (s.v. kedei), citing the Yerushalmi — When the Satan hears the sound of the shofar the first time, he is alarmed; when he hears it a second time, he says: Surely this is the great shofar that is to be blown, and the time has come for me to be swallowed up.

paragraphs.text: Parallel: Pri Tzaddik, Vayeilech and Shabbos Shuvah 16 — “It is brought in the Midrash that a king of flesh and blood decrees decrees and does not keep them himself, but the Holy One, blessed be He, keeps all the mitzvos; and so it says in the Gemara that the Holy One, blessed be He, puts on tefillin and prays… all the mitzvos and decrees of the Holy One, blessed be He, He, as it were, fulfills them first.” Connection: Both build on the Midrash that Hashem Himself fulfills the mitzvos He commands.

paragraphs.text: Berachos 6a — "Rabbi Avin bar Rav Ada said in the name of Rabbi Yitzchak: From where do we know that the Holy One puts on tefillin? As it says, 'Hashem has sworn by His right hand and by the arm of His strength' (Yeshayahu 62:8)… And what is written in the tefillin of the Master of the world? 'And who is like Your people Israel, one nation on earth' (I Divrei HaYamim 17:21)… The Holy One said to Israel: You have made Me one entity in the world, and I shall make you one entity in the world."
